data.title: Stateless Request
data.tagline: A stateless request is a model call that uses only what it receives this time and does not automatically retain prior input or results
data.learningOutcome: You can tell that a model sees only the material in the current request and that the product supplies the background.
data.description: If one request creates a table and the next contains only “continue,” the model does not know which table to continue. The product may save the table and chat, but it must include the current goal, table, and relevant result again.

learning.assumes: You have used chat or task pages that can refresh or reopen.
learning.outcome: You can tell that a model sees only the material in the current request and that the product supplies the background.

explanation.title: The model receives only this request
explanation.text: If the second call contains only “continue,” it lacks the earlier table, goal, and result.

explanation.title: The product retrieves saved material
explanation.text: The application can recover the current table, unfinished goal, and prior result from its records.

explanation.title: The new request includes what is needed
explanation.text: The application sends that material with “continue,” giving the model enough context this time.

data.boundary: Stateless does not mean the product cannot save data. Conversation history may be stored, but each model call still sees only what was actually sent.

lessonPractice.title: A server receives only Continue the previous table, with no table or prior result in the request. How should the model get context?

options.label: Have the application attach the current table, goal, and relevant prior result to each request
options.feedback: The request is stateless and the model can only use current input, so the application rebuilds required background.

options.label: Send only Continue and let the model recover previous content from the user account
options.feedback: An account or session does not mean the model retains prior requests, leaving Continue without a known object.

options.label: Keep the old table visible in the chat UI without adding it to the new request
options.feedback: UI storage supports display; only content assembled into the request can be read by the model.

data.agentPrompt: Treat every model call as stateless: send the current task, required data, relevant history, and expected output. Do not send only Continue or rely on visible messages; inspect the actual request for required context.
